title: Full-Stack Web Development
shortDesc: End-to-end web applications built with Next.js, React, Node.js, and MongoDB — from database to deployment.
fullDesc: I build complete, responsive web applications designed for performance and SEO. That includes database schema design, RESTful APIs, secure authentication, serverless functions, and interactive user interfaces.

title: Dashboard & Admin Panel Development
shortDesc: Custom management interfaces giving you real-time control over products, users, and business analytics.
fullDesc: Businesses need clear admin controls without touching code. I build custom admin dashboards with real-time data tables, dynamic charts, CSV exports, role-based access, and instant database CMS synchronization.

title: API Development & Integration
shortDesc: Secure, RESTful APIs powering web apps, mobile services, and third-party API integrations.
fullDesc: I engineer REST APIs using Node.js, Express, and Next.js Route Handlers with structured JSON payloads, JWT authentication middleware, rate limiting, and comprehensive endpoint documentation.

title: Database Architecture & Development

fullDesc: I design robust document databases optimized for high read/write performance, schema validation, data aggregation pipelines, and secure cloud backups on MongoDB Atlas.

title: Bug Fixing & Performance Optimization

fullDesc: I inspect existing React/Next.js applications to fix broken state logic, CSS layout bugs, hydration errors, slow API calls, and optimize bundle sizes for sub-second page loads.
